entities.name: 1,2-Dibromoethane
observations: Reactant and ethylene linker source in Williamson ether synthesis.

entities.name: Sodium hydroxide
observations: Base used to generate phenoxide for O-alkylation.

entities.name: Bromoethyl dibromophenyl ether
observations: Supported mono-O-alkylation product is 1-bromo-2-(2,5-dibromophenoxy)ethane, SMILES BrCCOc1cc(Br)ccc1Br.

entities.name: Williamson ether synthesis
observations: Base-promoted phenoxide SN2 displacement on 1,2-dibromoethane forms the monoalkylated aryl ether; one terminal bromide remains.
